comment: Fighter roster in a live lobby (issue 530): rule bots dressed by the server in distinct roster looks, at gameplay distance. Run on a lit and a dark map, for example LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MAP=1 LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_BOTS=8 LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/roster-lobby.json tools/qa_tour.sh (Larak Lot), then LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MAP=8 (Low Water at night). Add LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MODE=tdm for the Union side's issued livery and rank marks. The lineup of every look lives in client/qa/roster_review.gd.
